## Research at the intersection of cognitive neuroscience, EEG, and Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation

I am a Biomedical Engineering PhD student at Mississippi State University working to standardize Fast Periodic Visual Stimulation (FPVS) for use across cognitive neuroscience domains. My work focuses on end-to-end software for designing FPVS experiments and processing EEG data, with workflows built for non-experts, reproducible analysis, and reuse by other scientists and engineers.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Publications](publications.qmd){.btn .btn-outline}
:::

::: {.hero-panel}
**Current focus**

- Standardizing FPVS experiment and analysis workflows
- FPVS Toolbox
- FPVS Studio
- EEG applications in cognitive neuroscience

## Recent Updates

- **May 2026** - I have officially completed my Master of Science degree in Biomedical Engineering, and I am now a PhD student!

- **October 2025** - Our FPVS research on facial expression processing was published in *Brain and Cognition*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bandc.2025.106338){target="_blank"}
- **August 2025** - Our FPVS work on anxiety-linked neural sensitivity to emotional faces was published in *International Journal of Psychophysiology*. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijpsycho.2025.113212){target="_blank"}
